# transaction amount

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:transactionAmount`](gmeow-transactionAmount.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/transactionAmount>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/finance`](../../slices/finance.md)

The monetary amount of a financial transaction, expressed as a [`MonetaryAmount`](../classes/gmeow-MonetaryAmount.md). Functional: a single transaction occurrence has one canonical amount (disputed amounts are standpoint-indexed claims on separate statements, not additional values on the same transaction).
